name: Thermal Properties of Materials
summary: Explains heat capacity, thermal expansion, thermal conductivity and thermal shock, and why they matter for engines, electronics and spacecraft.

topics.name: Heat capacity: classical Dulong-Petit, Einstein and Debye models
Phonons as heat carriers: lattice vibrations and the phonon picture
Thermal expansion: anharmonic potentials, coefficient of thermal expansion and the Grüneisen parameter
Negative and near-zero expansion materials (Invar, ZrW2O8, Zerodur)
Thermal conductivity in metals (Wiedemann-Franz law) and in insulators (phonon scattering, Umklapp)
Thermal conductivity of polymers, composites, foams and aerogels
Thermal diffusivity and transient heat flow
Thermal stresses from constrained expansion and CTE mismatch
Thermal shock resistance and thermal shock parameters
Measuring thermal properties: laser flash, dilatometry, DSC
Thermal management materials: heat spreaders, thermal interface materials, insulators
